arxiv-1408-1899.title: Optical response of C 60 C_{60} fullerene from a Time Dependent Thomas Fermi approach
arxiv-1408-1899.creator: D. I. Palade, V.Baran
arxiv-1408-1899.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by D. I. Palade, V.Baran. We study the collective electron dynamics in C 60 C_{60} clusters within the Time Dependent Thomas Fermi method in the frame of jellium model. The results regarding the optical spectrum are in good agreement with the experimental data, our simulations being able to reproduce both resonances from 20 ​ e ​ V 20eV and 40 ​ e ​ V 40eV .

arxiv-2105-10944.title: The dominant scattering channel induced by two-body collision of D-band atoms in a triangular optical lattice
arxiv-2105-10944.creator: Xinxin Guo, Zhongcheng Yu, Peng Peng, Guoling Yin, Shengjie Jin, Xuzong Chen, Xiaoji Zhou
arxiv-2105-10944.description: Abstract The mechanism of atomic collisions in excited bands plays an important role both in the atomic dynamics in high bands of optical lattices and simulation of condensed matter physics. Atoms distributed in an excited band of an optical lattice can collide and decay to other bands through different scattering channels.

arxiv-2201-12673.title: Building time-surfaces by exploiting the complex volatility of an ECRAM memristor PubID: pubid: 0000–0000/00$00.00 © 2023 IEEE
arxiv-2201-12673.creator: Marco Rasetto, Qingzhou Wan, Himanshu Akolkar, Feng Xiong, Bertram Shi, Ryad Benosman
arxiv-2201-12673.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Marco Rasetto, Qingzhou Wan, Himanshu Akolkar, Feng Xiong, Bertram Shi, Ryad Benosman. Memristors have emerged as a promising technology for efficient neuromorphic architectures owing to their ability to act as programmable synapses, combining processing and memory into a single device. Although they are most commonly used for static encoding of synaptic weights, recent work has begun to investigate the use of their dynamical properties, such as Short Term Plasticity (STP), to integrate events over time in event-based architectures.

arxiv-2208-05852.title: Language Tokens: A Frustratingly Simple Approach Improves Zero-Shot Performance of Multilingual Translation
arxiv-2208-05852.creator: 𝐌𝐮𝐡𝐚𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐄𝐥𝐍𝐨𝐤𝐫𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐲 \mathsf{\vphantom{fg}\bf MuhammadElNokrashy} \addr muelnokr@microsoft.com, 𝐇𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐧𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐚 \mathsf{\vphantom{fg}\bf HanyHassanAwadalla} \addr hanyh@microsoft.com
arxiv-2208-05852.description: Abstract This paper proposes a simple yet effective method to improve direct ( X-to-Y ) translation for both cases: zero-shot and when direct data is available. We modify the input tokens at both the encoder and decoder to include signals for the source and target languages.

arxiv-2402-10021.title: SAWEC : Sensing-Assisted Wireless Edge Computing
arxiv-2402-10021.creator: Khandaker Foysal Haque † , Francesca Meneghello * , Md. Ebtidaul Karim † , and Francesco Restuccia †
arxiv-2402-10021.description: Abstract . Emerging mobile virtual reality (VR) systems will require to continuously perform complex computer vision tasks on ultra-high-resolution video frames through the execution of DNNs -based algorithms. Since state-of-the-art DNNs require computational power that is excessive for mobile devices, techniques based on wireless edge computing (WEC) have been recently proposed.

arxiv-2509-25647.title: BaB-prob : Branch and Bound with Preactivation Splitting for Probabilistic Verification of Neural Networks
arxiv-2509-25647.creator: Fangji Wang, Panagiotis Tsiotras
arxiv-2509-25647.description: Abstract Branch-and-bound with preactivation splitting has been shown highly effective for deterministic verification of neural networks. In this paper, we extend this framework to the probabilistic setting. We propose BaB-prob that iteratively divides the original problem into subproblems by splitting preactivations and leverages linear bounds computed by linear bound propagation to bound the probability for each subproblem.

pmc-11675043.title: Effectiveness of the Pediatric Nursing Excellence Model on Nurses’ Knowledge and Practice in Pediatric Orthopedic Surgery Care: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11675043.creator: Osama Mohamed Elsayed Ramadan, Alaa Hussain Hafiz, Nadia Bassuoni Elsharkawy, Nouran Essam Katooa, Areej Abunar, Enas Mahrous Abdelaziz, Samia Ibrahim Mabrouk Baraka, Mostafa Shaban, Nagwa Ibrahim Mabrouk Baraka
pmc-11675043.description: Background: Pediatric orthopedic nursing requires specialized competencies to optimize patient outcomes, particularly in the complex realm of pediatric surgery. This study explores the effectiveness of the Pediatric Nursing Excellence (PNE) Model in enhancing nurses’ knowledge and clinical practice in providing perioperative care for pediatric orthopedic patients in tertiary care inpatient settings.

pmc-12532761.title: Zonal endothelial cell heterogeneity underlies murine renal vascular development
pmc-12532761.creator: Peter M Luo, Neha H Ahuja, Christopher Chaney, Danielle Pi, Aleksandra Cwiek, Zaneta Markowska, Chitkale Hiremath, Denise K Marciano, Karen K Hirschi, M Luisa Iruela-Arispe, Thomas J Carroll, Ondine Cleaver
pmc-12532761.description: The renal vasculature consists of highly specialized blood vessels with distinct physiological functions. Defining their transcriptional signatures and tracing their developmental ontogeny has thus far been challenging due to a lack of regionally specific endothelial biomarkers. Here, we performed single nuclear RNA sequencing (snucRNA-Seq) to interrogate the transcriptional heterogeneity of embryonic renal endothelial cells (ECs).

pmc-12781215.title: The Effectiveness of Mindfulness-Based Interventions for Depressive Symptoms and Their Relationship to Interoceptive Awareness: A Systematic Review
pmc-12781215.creator: Samantha Knep, Alice Shires
pmc-12781215.description: Background:This systematic review aimed to investigate the effectiveness of mindfulness-based interventions (MBIs) in treating depression, enhancing interoceptive awareness (IA), and whether IA mediates this relationship.Methods:In August 2024, a comprehensive literature search was conducted in web-based medical and psychological databases, including PsycINFO, MEDLINE, and Scopus, following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines.

pmc-12953823.title: Differences in Psoas Major Muscle Properties Between Elite Athletes with and Without Chronic Low Back Pain
pmc-12953823.creator: Emma Feng Ming Zhou, Arnold Yu Lok Wong, Guohui Lin, Jiebin Huang, Jianhui Fang, Wenting Liang, Xiongmao Cai, Siu Ngor Fu
pmc-12953823.description: BackgroundDespite the proposed link between psoas major (PM) muscle dysfunction and low back pain (LBP), the relationship remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the association between PM muscle properties, particularly stiffness, and chronic LBP in elite athletes.MethodsNinety-nine elite athletes (age: 10 to 32 years) from gymnastics and wushu (kung fu) teams were recruited. Fifty-three had chronic LBP.

pmc-13166761.title: Weight-adjusted waist index and cognitive impairment in older adults: A nationwide longitudinal cohort study
pmc-13166761.creator: Hongli Nie, Xuexue Huang, Xiaohong Yu, Wenzhen Yang, Peiwen Li
pmc-13166761.description: The association between adiposity and cognitive impairment remains inconclusive. This study aimed to evaluate the relationship between weight-adjusted waist index (WWI), a newly proposed indicator of adiposity, and cognitive impairment in a Chinese middle-aged and elderly population. Data from the 2011–2018 China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study were used in this study.

pmc-13252693.title: Short-term functional outcome and pain assessment after spinal decompression for spondylodiscitis
pmc-13252693.creator: Bogdan Șendrea, Bogdan Gabriel Voicu, Sebastian Mihai Valeanu, Andrei Tudorache, Mihaela Gabriela Stanciu, Romica Cergan
pmc-13252693.description: Spondylodiscitis, though rare, is a serious condition that can lead to disability or death. It may be caused by pyogenic, granulomatous (e.g., tuberculosis, brucellosis, fungal), or rarely, parasitic infections. Pain and neurological deficits typically result from bone destruction, deformity, and mass effect.

pmc-13330463.title: Evaluating measurement invariance and diagnostic accuracy of climate anxiety scales in aging populations: a multi-instrument approach
pmc-13330463.creator: Fakhruddin Boraghi, Shazia Soomro, Hassan Hashemi, Seyedeh Hakimeh Moosavi, Tahereh Ghaedi, Abdolrahim Asadollahi
pmc-13330463.description: Climate change is increasingly recognized as a psychological stressor, with older adults representing a particularly vulnerable yet understudied group. This study evaluated the psychometric performance of three climate anxiety measures—the Hogge Climate Anxiety Scale (HCAS), Clayton Climate Change Anxiety Scale (CCCA), and Simon Climate Anxiety Scale (SCAS)—among 279 Persian-speaking older adults in Iran.

pmc-13368383.title: Placa horizontal em banda de tensão: Uma nova estratégia para fraturas desviadas e multifragmentares da tuberosidade anterior da tíbia associadas a fraturas metafisárias complexas
pmc-13368383.creator: Robinson Esteves Pires, Gustavo Waldolato Silva, Rafael Chagas Silva, Erick Veiga Franco da Rosa
pmc-13368383.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ResumoNão existe padronização de tratamento para as fraturas multifragmentares da tuberosidade anterior da tíbia (TAT) nos pacientes adultos, com ou sem associação com fraturas metafisárias da tíbia proximal. O objetivo desta nota técnica é demonstrar os resultados da utilização da placa de minifragmentos colocada segundo o princípio da banda de tensão, de forma horizontal, em dois pacientes portadores de fratura multifragmentar da TAT.
